copy.headline: North Texas politician blasts Northwest ISD over Islam lesson; district reminds him he set the curriculum
copy.caption: Northwest ISD says its teachers faced harassment after State Board of Education member Brandon Hall criticized a state-mandated World Geography lesson on Islam.
